note: Written by hand before any run. 'hardened' is the outcome HARDENING-DESIGN.md specifies (verdict and the sorted finding list KIND@location); no implementation exists, so it is checked by review, not by execution. 'current_predicted' is the exit status, problem tags and reported count predicted for the unmodified production checker by reading its code; run_fixtures.py checks that column. Locations: OIBridge/<M>.lean:<line> for a print or report key, log:<n> for a physical log line (1-based), log for the whole log.

M01.change: match a print to any report with the same final name component (the current checker's key)

M02.change: match a print to any report whose fully qualified name extends the written name, ignoring position

M03.change: ASCII-only identifier grammar, fail-closed rules kept

M04.change: ignore report-like lines that do not parse

M05.change: ignore print lines that do not parse

M08.change: keep the first of several identical reports at one position

M09.change: keep the first of several distinct reports at one position

M10.change: drop the name check between the written and the reported name

M12.change: parse each report from a single physical line

M13.change: do not strip a leading _root_ from the written name

M14.change: reject a trailing line comment after the printed name

M17.change: add Lean.ofReduceBool to the permitted axioms

M18.change: require the reported name to equal the written name exactly

M19.change: key prints and reports by line alone, without the module
